product.name: Monoprice Commercial Series Rolling Stand for Landscape Displays with Storage Shelf Fits 37 to 75 TVs
product.description: Monoprice™Commercial Series Rolling Stand for Landscape Displays with Storage Shelf, Fits 37-75in TVsThe Monoprice Commercial Series Rolling Stand is a mobile, floor-standing solution designed for large landscape-oriented displays in professional environments. It supports 37" to 75" flat or curved TVs up to 110 lb (50 kg) and includes a built-in storage shelf for AV equipment, making it well suited for offices, classrooms, and conference rooms where displays need to move between spaces.Freestanding steel frame with smooth-rolling casters for safe repositioning between roomsSupports flat or curved TVs from 37" to 75" and up to 110 lb (50 kg)VESA mounting patterns from 200×200 to 600×400Integrated shelf rated to support up to 11 lb (5 kg) of AV hardwareSuitable for shared rooms, presentations, and flexible AV deploymentsProfessional installation required; team lifting recommended during setupIndoor, controlled-environment use onlyCompatible with VESA mounting interfaces as defined by the Video Electronics Standards Association MOBILE FLOOR-STANDING DISPLAY SUPPORTThis stand enables large displays to be deployed without wall mounting. A freestanding steel frame combined with smooth-rolling casters allows displays to be repositioned safely between rooms, supporting temporary installations and shared spaces where flexibility is required. WIDE DISPLAY SIZE AND WEIGHT COMPATIBILITYThe stand supports larger commercial displays used in professional settings. It accommodates flat or curved TVs from 37" to 75" and supports a maximum display weight of 110 lb (50 kg), providing stable support for larger screens. VESA MOUNTING STANDARD SUPPORTThe mounting interface is compatible with common commercial display standards. It supports Video Electronics Standards Association (VESA®) mounting patterns from 200×200 to 600×400, covering most displays within the supported size range. INTEGRATED EQUIPMENT STORAGE SHELFThe integrated shelf keeps essential AV hardware organized at the display location. Rated to support up to 11 lb (5 kg), the shelf is suitable for media players, mini-PCs, or wireless presentation devices. DESIGNED FOR INDOOR PROFESSIONAL USEThe stand is intended for controlled indoor environments.
